breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflicting grid definitions. The incomplete prompt contained a general preamble with two contradictory grid conventions. The agent correctly ignored the incorrect override for a closed interval (dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)) and followed the specific instruction for the periodic domain provided later in the prompt (dx=1/Nx). The generated specification correctly states 'dx=1/512', which aligns with the ground truth's resolution of removing the contradictory text.
